subject: Re: Lost Frames EP1 — LegacyLens sponsor read confirmed
snippet: Helen — we are good for EP1. LOI is being drafted, our marketing has the 15-second mid-roll script.
body:
Helen,

Quick confirmation: LegacyLens Cameras is locked in for Lost Frames EP1 as the mid-roll sponsor. Our legal team has the LOI in flight, expect it by end of week. The 15-second read your team drafted works for us — just verify the discount code 'LOSTFRAMES15' is live on our side before launch.

Looking forward to the season.

Mark Holland | VP Brand Partnerships | LegacyLens Cameras

subject: Crescent Pictures — multi-episode sponsorship interest
snippet: Helen, we love the Lost Frames pitch deck. Internally aligned on a 6-episode pilot package.
